verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. لِدَاوُدَ. مَزْمُورٌ يَارَبُّ، قَدِ ٱخْتَبَرْتَنِي وَعَرَفْتَنِي.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known [me].
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ عَرَفْتَ جُلُوسِي وَقِيَامِي. فَهِمْتَ فِكْرِي مِنْ بَعِيدٍ.
verses.kjv: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.web: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

verses.ar: مَسْلَكِي وَمَرْبَضِي ذَرَّيْتَ، وَكُلَّ طُرُقِي عَرَفْتَ.
verses.kjv: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted [with] all my ways.
verses.web: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ كَلِمَةٌ فِي لِسَانِي، إِلَّا وَأَنْتَ يَارَبُّ عَرَفْتَهَا كُلَّهَا.
verses.kjv: For [there is] not a word in my tongue, [but], lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.web: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.

verses.ar: مِنْ خَلْفٍ وَمِنْ قُدَّامٍ حَاصَرْتَنِي، وَجَعَلْتَ عَلَيَّ يَدَكَ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.web: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

verses.ar: عَجِيبَةٌ هَذِهِ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةُ، فَوْقِي ٱرْتَفَعَتْ، لَا أَسْتَطِيعُهَا.
verses.kjv: [Such] knowledge [is] too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot [attain] unto it.
verses.web: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

verses.ar: أَيْنَ أَذْهَبُ مِنْ رُوحِكَ؟ وَمِنْ وَجْهِكَ أَيْنَ أَهْرُبُ؟
verses.kjv: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.web: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

verses.ar: إِنْ صَعِدْتُ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ فَأَنْتَ هُنَاكَ، وَإِنْ فَرَشْتُ فِي ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ فَهَا أَنْتَ.
verses.kjv: If I ascend up into heaven, thou [art] there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou [art there].
verses.web: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

verses.ar: إِنْ أَخَذْتُ جَنَاحَيِ ٱلصُّبْحِ، وَسَكَنْتُ فِي أَقَاصِي ٱلْبَحْرِ،
verses.kjv: [If] I take the wings of the morning, [and] dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.web: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

verses.ar: فَهُنَاكَ أَيْضًا تَهْدِينِي يَدُكَ وَتُمْسِكُنِي يَمِينُكَ.
verses.kjv: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.web: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

verses.ar: فَقُلْتُ: «إِنَّمَا ٱلظُّلْمَةُ تَغْشَانِي». فَٱللَّيْلُ يُضِيءُ حَوْلِي!
verses.kjv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.web: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

verses.ar: ٱلظُّلْمَةُ أَيْضًا لَا تُظْلِمُ لَدَيْكَ، وَٱللَّيْلُ مِثْلَ ٱلنَّهَارِ يُضِيءُ. كَٱلظُّلْمَةِ هَكَذَا ٱلنُّورُ.
verses.kjv: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light [are] both alike [to thee].
verses.web: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱقْتَنَيْتَ كُلْيَتَيَّ. نَسَجْتَنِي فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّي.
verses.kjv: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.
verses.web: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

verses.ar: أَحْمَدُكَ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنِّي قَدِ ٱمْتَزْتُ عَجَبًا. عَجِيبَةٌ هِيَ أَعْمَالُكَ، وَنَفْسِي تَعْرِفُ ذَلِكَ يَقِينًا.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully [and] wonderfully made: marvellous [are] thy works; and [that] my soul knoweth right well.
verses.web: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

verses.ar: لَمْ تَخْتَفِ عَنْكَ عِظَامِي حِينَمَا صُنِعْتُ فِي ٱلْخَفَاءِ، وَرُقِمْتُ فِي أَعْمَاقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, [and] curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.web: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

verses.ar: رَأَتْ عَيْنَاكَ أَعْضَائِي، وَفِي سِفْرِكَ كُلُّهَا كُتِبَتْ يَوْمَ تَصَوَّرَتْ، إِذْ لَمْ يَكُنْ وَاحِدٌ مِنْهَا.
verses.kjv: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all [my members] were written, [which] in continuance were fashioned, when [as yet there was] none of them.
verses.web: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

verses.ar: مَا أَكْرَمَ أَفْكَارَكَ يَا ٱللهُ عِنْدِي! مَا أَكْثَرَ جُمْلَتَهَا!
verses.kjv: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
verses.web: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

verses.ar: إِنْ أُحْصِهَا فَهِيَ أَكْثَرُ مِنَ ٱلرَّمْلِ. ٱسْتَيْقَظْتُ وَأَنَا بَعْدُ مَعَكَ.
verses.kjv: [If] I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.web: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

verses.ar: لَيْتَكَ تَقْتُلُ ٱلْأَشْرَارَ يَا ٱللهُ. فَيَا رِجَالَ ٱلدِّمَاءِ، ٱبْعُدُوا عَنِّي.
verses.kjv: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
verses.web: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَلِّمُونَكَ بِٱلْمَكْرِ نَاطِقِينَ بِٱلْكَذِبِ، هُمْ أَعْدَاؤُكَ.
verses.kjv: For they speak against thee wickedly, [and] thine enemies take [thy name] in vain.
verses.web: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

verses.ar: أَلَا أُبْغِضُ مُبْغِضِيكَ يَارَبُّ، وَأَمْقُتُ مُقَاوِمِيكَ؟
verses.kjv: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.web: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

verses.ar: بُغْضًا تَامًّا أَبْغَضْتُهُمْ. صَارُوا لِي أَعْدَاءً.
verses.kjv: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
verses.web: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

verses.ar: ٱخْتَبِرْنِي يَا ٱللهُ وَٱعْرِفْ قَلْبِي. ٱمْتَحِنِّي وَٱعْرِفْ أَفْكَارِي.
verses.kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.web: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

verses.ar: وَٱنْظُرْ إِنْ كَانَ فِيَّ طَرِيقٌ بَاطِلٌ، وَٱهْدِنِي طَرِيقًا أَبَدِيًّا.
verses.kjv: And see if [there be any] wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.web: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
